annotation.title_clean: FAR Part 52—Solicitation Provisions and Contract Clauses
annotation.title_en: FAR Part 52—Solicitation Provisions and Contract Clauses
annotation.authors_or_issuer: FAR Council (DoD, GSA, NASA), United States
annotation.summary_en: Federal Acquisition Regulation Part 52 sets out the standard US federal solicitation provisions and contract clauses, rules for incorporating and modifying them, and the clause matrix. Covers anti-kickback, lobbying, ethics, whistleblower, SAM registration and Buy American requirements. Contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prescribes standard text of FAR provisions and clauses for federal contracts
Provisions and clauses should be incorporated by reference where practicable
Contractors must maintain codes of business ethics and report credible evidence of fraud
Anti-kickback, lobbying limits and whistleblower protections apply to contractors
Offerors must register in SAM and submit annual representations and certifications
